description: This file defines the EntityNotCondition class, which implements the EntityCondition interface to represent a negation (NOT) condition in a database query within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods for condition evaluation, string representation, and integration with the framework's condition visitor pattern.

classes.name: EntityNotCondition
classes.description: Represents a negated (NOT) condition within the entity condition system, allowing for query negation and complex condition composition.

methods.name: EntityNotCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the condition to be negated.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to perform operations based on the Visitor design pattern.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another object is equal to this condition based on the encapsulated condition.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for this condition, combining the string 'NOT' with the hash code of the encapsulated condition.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the condition is empty; always returns false.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Generates the SQL WHERE clause fragment representing this condition.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Checks the validity of the condition with respect to the model entity.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Evaluates whether the map matches the negated condition.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the condition, delegating to makeWhereString().

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns an immutable version of this condition.
